# Fusing parse and tape: landed slices (plan: `docs/perf/fuse-plan.md`)

Every number says local. One line per slice: what landed, theorem names, Tier 1 time.

- F0 `LeanJsonProofs/Layout.lean`: the layout as a pure function (`tapeV`, `textV`, `wordsV`) and the layout theorem `encValue_layout` / `encValue_empty`; `close_layout` (the patch of a closed node's header words, reused by F3). No production line.
- F3 `LeanJson/Tape.lean` (`FStack`, `TapeBuf.closeNode`, 13 production lines) and `LeanJsonProofs/FastTape.lean`: `closeNode_arr`, `closeNode_obj` (header with placeholders, the children, then the two-word patch IS `encValue` of the container), `node_empty_arr`/`node_empty_obj`.
- F1 `LeanJson/Tape.lean` (`scanNum`, `pushLex`, `TapeBuf.numLex`) and `LeanJsonProofs/FastNum.lean`: `scanNum_eq` (the end index of `parseNumA`), `pushLex_eq` (copying `a[i..j)` with `E`→`e`, `+` dropped is `pushNumber` of the parsed number, via `parseNum_sound` and `num_lex`), `numLex_eq : s.numLex a i j = s.num n`.
- F2 `LeanJson/Tape.lean` (`pushChar`, `strBytes`, `TapeBuf.strNode`) and `LeanJsonProofs/FastStr.lean`: `strBytes_eq` (same stops as `strLoop`, text = start text + UTF-8 of the string it builds; the char encoder is the body of core `String.utf8EncodeCharFast`, so no arithmetic bridge), `strNode_eq : s.strNode kind a i = (parseStrA a i).map (leaf kind ·.toUTF8)`.
- F4 `LeanJson/Tape.lean` (`runT`, `parseTapeFast`, `tapeOk`/`tapeErr`, `TapeBuf.keyNode`; about 70 production lines) is the whole loop, containers included, written once: `run`'s branches in `run`'s order with the tape and the open containers' header positions in place of the `Value`. NOT exported and NOT yet proved (the proof lands in slices F4 helpers, F5, F6: nothing says "verified" about it). Stage A of the method: it sits BESIDE `parseTape` and is differential-tested against it in Tier 1 (`vbm-json-vectors --check`: every row, the random and mutated inputs, the 100000-deep document, the long array and string; the negative self-test is three wrong fused parsers; `--corpus DIR` runs the same on the perf corpora).
  Preview measurement (local, scratch copy with the export pointed at `parseTapeFast`, `docs/perf/bench.sh`, same session as the base): see `docs/perf/results.md` slice 3.
- F4 helpers + F5 `LeanJsonProofs/FastLoop.lean` (no production line): `openTape`/`FRel` (the tape and the header positions an open `Stack` stands for), `encList_snoc`/`encMembers_snoc`, the `WF` lemmas, `keyNode_eq`, and the simulation `runT_sim`: for every fuel and every related state, `runT` returns `finT` of what `run` returns (`finT` = the tape bytes of the value, or the error bytes). The whole loop (scalars and containers) in one induction, branch by branch as `run_sound`: the fuel needs no bound because both loops spend it in lock step.
- F6/F7: `parseTapeFast_eq : parseTapeFast a = parseTape a` (`LeanJsonProofs/FastLoop.lean`), plus `parseTapeFast_ok`/`parseTapeFast_error` against the reference; the export `vbm_json_parse_tape` is `parseTapeFast` (`parseTape` is a plain definition now); `scripts/closure-entries.txt` has `LeanJson.parseTapeFast` in place of `LeanJson.parseTape`; ledger claim `tape-encode-decode` is `partly`. The fused code lives in `LeanJson/Tape.lean` (not a new module): the C edge initialises `LeanJson.Tape` only, and the export's closed terms are initialised with the module that defines them.

Landed (main): F0 `4970da2`, F3 `82e44cb`, F1 `4f2c94d`, F2 `f9260ed`, F4 `1de5ce6`, F4 helpers + F5 `1d4c20e`, F6/F7 `127abfa`. Tier 1 seconds as printed by land-direct (F0 27 s, F3 39, F1 40, F2 46, F4 32, F5 26, F6/F7 33, all local). The wasm, native, bindings and ABI tests and the 43707 vector rows pass on the fused export. One test change: `tests/native_rt.c` warms up the error path before it takes the heap baseline (the fused path allocates 80 bytes once on the first error parse; flat over 6000 more parses; the runtime mutants are still caught).
Open: the ledger claim `tape-encode-decode` is `partly` (the reader/decoder theorem is not proved); `docs/trust-ledger.md` still says "no proof yet" in its slice-1 snapshot paragraph (a dated snapshot).
